dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-back region to a refined point at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slightly asymmetrical lateral margins with a more pronounced outward curvature on the left flank relative to the right.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with low-intensity grayscale values localized to lateral shadow regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Three parallel, curvilinear light-colored rake marks located on the mid-dorsal right quadrant; one distinct dark circular aperture at the blowhole site.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Proninent longitudinal raised ridge extending along the central dorsal axis from the mid-body to the tail.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear rake marks on the upper dorsal surface and a long, continuous longitudinal scar or structural ridge on the posterior dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast, dark circular blowhole aperture visible on the anterior dorsal surface.
